description: Writer output exercising every escape it can emit: \uN with a one-character ASCII fallback, a surrogate pair, \tab, \par, and the three metacharacters
notes: Every byte is ASCII by construction - the writer never emits a raw high byte, because a reader under a different \ansicpg would decode one as a different character rather than as a visible gap. The em dash falls back to '-' and the emoji to '??', one fallback character per \uN as \uc1 in the header promises. Decodes to 'caf\u00e9 \u2014 \U0001f600\ttab\nbreak {braces} \\slash'.
